provenance.l: Vega 2 — 1,500 kg descent unit (2.4 m sphere), entry at 125 km and ~11 km/s, first parachute at 64 km; entry to touchdown ~02:06:04 → 03:00:50 UT (3286 s). Lander mass after the balloon and shell leave, chute release altitude and disc drag are estimates fitted to the 3286 s

Dutta et al. 2012, Mission sizing and trade studies for low ballistic coefficient entry systems to Venus, Table 1 — entry angle, speed and peak g of Venera and Vega (simulated from engineering estimates)
